lines.text: Many learners say: The book of Ana is on the table.
Better: Ana’s book is on the table.
The second! Ana’s phone is here.

options: The phone of Ana is here.

native.tip: Para dizer de quem é algo, é mais natural usar “’s” depois do nome.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “The book of Ana is on the table.” O certo é “Ana’s book is on the table.” Em português dizemos “o livro da Ana”, mas em inglês colocamos o dono antes: “Ana’s book”. Ouça a Ama e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “Ana’s phone is here.” Agora escreva uma frase sua com esse ponto e treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.hook: Do you say “The book of Ana”?
en.tip: To show who owns something, it is more natural to add “’s” after the name.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “The book of Ana is on the table.” The right way is “Ana’s book is on the table.” In Portuguese we say “o livro da Ana”, but in English the owner comes first: “Ana’s book”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
